clauses.text: Prices as per the price annex, fixed for each calendar year. Changes require written notice of at least 60 days before the end of the calendar year.

The price follows index AS-14301: P = P0 x (1 - 0.45 + 0.45 x I(m-2) / I(base)), base = the index two months before the price year starts, adjusted quarterly on the 1st of January, April, July and October if the change exceeds 0 %.
Delivery DAP; standard lead time 14 days from order.
The quality agreement applies: on-time delivery target 95 %, flat fee of EUR 150 per supplier-caused complaint.
Valid from 2024-01-01 to 2026-12-31; extends by 12 months unless terminated with 60 days' notice.

documents.subject: Material purchasing
documents.author: Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing
documents.text: Call with Inox Center Ostalpen GmbH: they bought their nickel and alloys forward until January 2027 and said the market price is 'not our reality' before then.

documents.subject: Annual review
documents.author: Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing
documents.text: Annual review with Inox Center Ostalpen GmbH. Their key account manager explained that price changes above 2 % need the approval of their pricing committee, which meets every two weeks.

documents.subject: Holiday shutdown
documents.author: Inox Center Ostalpen GmbH
documents.text: Our plant is closed from 23 December to 6 January. Please place call-offs for January by 10 December.

quote_remarks.remarks: Material covered until January 2027; price valid accordingly.

persona.summary: Private Austrian stainless stockholder (76 M EUR); we are 0.35 %. Sole active source for 1.4301 sheet, but 70710 is qualified (0 % quota): a credible switch. Nickel and alloys bought forward to January 2027, so falling market prices are 'not our reality'. Contract already has an AS-14301 clause (45 %). Owner offered open-book costing; moves above 2 % need its pricing committee. Push with 70710 and its own cost shares, not market falls.
persona.notes: Fears losing the sheet to qualified 70710; needs its forward cover priced in until Jan 2027. Note: hedged, yet its price is down 20.6 % since the first price under the index-clause contract and renewals. Delivery excellent (OTD 96-100 %), so quality is no lever.
fears: market prices below its forward cover

arguments: a quote from 70710 (qualified for the same sheet; none in our data yet)
hedge ends Jan 2027: from then its cost follows the market
avoid: today's falling nickel or alloy index (hedged to 2027-01)
changing terms after its final offer
tactics: Point to 70710 being qualified for the 1.4301 sheet; with a real 70710 quote expect half the step now, the rest next round.
Do not argue the current nickel fall; it is hedged to January 2027 and will use that against us.
Keep the quarterly AS-14301 clause so market falls after its hedge expires reach our price.
Ask for its calculation (the owner offered it) and argue from its own material share.
Keep steps near 2 % (pricing committee) and never reopen terms after its final offer.
playbook.expected_concession: No arena data; history settles 2-3 % below its own ask (kept 130 %); expect moderate moves once a rival quote is on the table.
